prayerExcerpt.en-US: "Answer me, O sinner!" St. Thomas would say, "what can you purchase with your money better or more necessary than the redemption of your sins?"
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Responde-me, ó pecador!", costumava dizer São Tomás, "que podes comprar com o teu dinheiro melhor ou mais necessário do que a redenção dos teus pecados?"

meta.face: A Castilian of La Mancha of about sixty-five, CLEAN-SHAVEN, with a warm olive complexion and a LONG, SOFT OVAL face after his Spanish portraits — a high forehead RECEDING at the temples, a LONG, straight nose with a FLESHY, rounded tip, LARGE, dark eyes under HEAVY, DROOPING upper lids, lowered in thought, thick, straight dark brows with a deep vertical CREASE between them, smooth, full cheeks, a FULL lower lip, a soft, rounded jaw with a hint of fullness beneath the chin; short dark hair touched with grey under the mitre; the gaze lowered, gentle and grave. Not the wide, angular, broad-jawed john_sahagun, nor the lean, narrow, fine-nosed thomas_becket.
meta.basis: Spanish portraits (Wikipedia's lead engraving and the Spanish article's painting) show a clean-shaven, long, soft-oval face with a long nose and heavy lids, eyes lowered, in mitre and cope; Santi e Beati gives episcopal dress, mitre, crosier and book. The purse and the poor child are his almsgiving, which the book tells.
